action: No action needed; for awareness. Organisations that depend on weather service data feeds should confirm that those feeds are current.
exec: A reported federal communications problem on the day of the FAA halt that the agency later described as old webpage text; no cyber cause reported.
plain: A notice on a National Weather Service webpage on November 13 said it had nationwide internet and communications problems. FOX 17 reports the agency later said old text was circulating and radars were normal.
summary: A National Weather Service Los Angeles webpage notice said the agency was having nationwide internet and communications problems on November 13, the day of the FAA ground stop. FOX 17 reports NWS later said on X that old webpage text was circulating and its radars were normal. No cyber cause has been reported.
title: US National Weather Service reports nationwide internet and communications issues

validation.note: FOX 17 (published 13 Nov 2026) read: NWS Los Angeles page notice, no posting date; NWS said on X no radar outage, outdated info circulating. Christian Science Monitor returns 403 and was removed from sources.
